name: UWCSEA East
summary: Tampines IB campus serving east-side families with the same UWC mission as Dover.
body: UWCSEA East mirrors Dover’s IB pathway with an east-coast catchment — convenient for Marine Parade, Katong, and Pasir Ris households. Expect the same emphasis on service, outdoor education, and international diversity. Campus choice is often geography-led within the UWCSEA system.
waitlistNotes: Apply early; campus preference is not guaranteed.
